issues.title: Add truncate(text, n)
issues.body: textkit has no way to shorten text. Add truncate(text, n): text longer than n is cut to n-1 characters plus an ellipsis; shorter text is returned as is. [patch:truncate]

issues.title: Add unique_words(text)
issues.body: textkit counts words but not distinct ones. Add unique_words(text): the number of distinct words, split on any whitespace, case sensitive. [patch:unique-words]
